improvements.message: Consider adding more advanced scoring criteria, such as sentiment analysis or viewer retention metrics, to improve highlight ranking accuracy.
Upgrade local storage to IndexedDB for better scalability and support for larger datasets.
Expand the UX design specification to include accessibility considerations, such as keyboard navigation and screen reader support.
Add tests for edge cases, such as importing extremely large datasets or handling unexpected input formats.
Include a section on future scalability options, such as transitioning to a backend API for data processing and storage.

payload.quality_target: Enhance scalability, scoring accuracy, and accessibility.
